ownership: Child animations remain registered allocations outside the manager Add vector. They retain parent and attached Thing lifetimes.
Parent Book/Constant PostUpdate handles a finished child before its own manager death.
OnChildFinished optionally extracts the finished child's descendant when source TransferChildren=true, releases the finished child, then adds its ChainTo under the same parent.

Replacement receives the parent raw attachment offset, parallax, and WobbleOffsetZ component. A preserved descendant appends at the replacement tail, or at the original parent if there is no replacement.
Child completion does not run the manager-root OnDeath/CreateAnimationOnEnd/CopyState path.
position: Native attachment offset at Animation+a0 is raw world XY added by GetLocation. Source draw OffsetX/Y initialize Animation+90 at2923db/e3 and are independently added with draw shifts and attached Body scale in GetDrawLocation. Child replacement and CopyState copy the former without overwriting the latter.
movie_geometry: Shared ActionEffectState owns native Book timing, children, source color and transition state; HAA is the actual movie image backend. Resolve the exact original frame and native full-angle index, then the documented nearest exported original angle. Strip baked source Scale/offset from clip geometry while preserving inverse Bink atlas scale, crop and original midpoint pivot; common native draw transforms apply source/live values once.
isometric: Movie Book defaults UseIsometricAngle=true from constructor fullData+9d. It uses the same source-bound 720-entry inverse-isometric lookup and native rounding as HAA Thing primaries. Unit facing supplies cosmetic angle, ordinary Thing uses Body angle.
limits: Selected-angle asset coverage remains a documented reduction from the complete native angle set.
Detached-parent child ChainTo requires the ownerless lineage factory; it fails explicitly.
Nonzero parent WobbleOffsetZ transfer requires its actual entity component and fails explicitly.
Movie explicit origin requires original Bink atlas extent/trim metadata; it fails explicitly.
